question: Among customer states with at least 1000 delivered orders with a known delivery date, which state has the highest share of late deliveries (delivered after the estimated date)?
sql:
WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        c.customer_state,
        o.order_delivered_customer_date,
        o.order_estimated_delivery_date,
        CASE
            WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_late
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
      AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    customer_state,
    SUM(is_late)::DOUBLE / COUNT(*) AS late_share
FROM delivered
GROUP BY customer_state
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY late_share DESC
LIMIT 1
